name: forkhead box P1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: FOXP1 encodes forkhead box protein P1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include intellectual disability-severe speech delay-mild dysmorphism syndrome (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Marginal zone lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
